description.id: Program tidak dibuat hanya untuk seremonial, tetapi berdasarkan isu, wilayah, dan kebutuhan penerima manfaat.
description.en: Programs are not made just for ceremonies, but based on issues, regions, and beneficiary needs.

description.id: Setiap program dapat dilengkapi indikator, dokumentasi, progres, dan laporan dampak yang rapi.
description.en: Each program can be equipped with indicators, documentation, progress, and neat impact reports.

description.id: Format program dapat disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan komunikasi CSR, ESG, atau sustainability report perusahaan.
description.en: Program formats can be adjusted to CSR communication, ESG, or corporate sustainability report needs.

description.id: Mitra dapat memilih berbagai isu seperti pendidikan, kesehatan, gizi, air bersih, energi, lingkungan, dan pemberdayaan.
description.en: Partners can choose various issues such as education, health, nutrition, clean water, energy, environment, and empowerment.
